summary: Verified all 26 estimates against the saved PDF after reading the complete markdown conversion, including references and Appendices A-I. All 222 checked numeric statistics/count cells match the appropriate PDF table rows; the study counts and all requested coding fields are supported by the methods. The extraction correctly retains printed signs for the two change interactions and explains their control-minus-treatment orientation. The documented discrepancies between the prose and Tables 3 and 12-13 are paper inconsistencies, not transcription errors. No confirmed eligible full-sample contrast is missing. Study 2 reports additional outcomes, but random assignment of its idea generators is not stated in the saved paper; its eligibility therefore remains unconfirmed, as the extraction records. The elaboration-depth analysis uses a selected subset, and the standalone within-arm changes have fixed initial-then-refined order; their exclusions are consistent with the specified full-sample randomized-contrast scope.
